youtubeTitle: Every factory that now runs in India once existed only as someone's stubborn bet that it could.
caption:
Every factory that now runs in India once existed only as someone's stubborn bet that it could.

Nobody hands a country its manufacturing base. It gets built one skipped shortcut, one hard year, one factory floor at a time - by people who decided to bet on capability instead of waiting for it to arrive.

Independent citizen project. Not affiliated with the Government of India.
